$about: Every request the mod makes of the website and every answer it reads, in order. A step is one request and one answer. Read README.md for the fields. Variables in braces ({ann.id}, {bob.id}, {carol.id}, {post.id}, {plan}, {emptyPlan}) are filled by each runner.

example.error: Password must be at least 6 characters.

result.refused: Password must be at least 6 characters.

server.skip: the limit is 20 attempts in 10 minutes from one address; the shape is the same as every other refusal
the server always sets the cookie on a 200; the mod treats a 200 without one as a failure to sign in

steps.note: The mod sends its stored token; a server that no longer knows it answers 200 with a null user. The server run sends no cookie, which gets the same answer.
The server names no id here; the account id is the first part of the session token, as Account.accountId reads it.

server.skip: the server never answers 401 here (a null user is its answer); the mod accepts a 401 as signed out for a proxy in front of it

steps.note: A static file under public/, not a route. One call of the client makes both requests, this one then the next; the call's result is on this step. The server run reads the file from its own dataset folder and uses its first version with a gtnhVersion of 2.9.0 as {dataset.id}.
The server run checks status and shape only: its dataset is its own pack's.
